اجتمعت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَمَعْتُ (ijtamaʕtu) /id͡ʒ.ta.maʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# اِجْتَمَعْتَ (ijtamaʕta) /id͡ʒ.ta.maʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# اِجْتَمَعْتِ (ijtamaʕti) /id͡ʒ.ta.maʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# اِجْتَمَعَتْ (ijtamaʕat) /id͡ʒ.ta.ma.ʕat/: thi
